# International Journal of Multidisciplinary Research and Growth Evaluation

> An open-access, peer-reviewed multidisciplinary academic journal committed to BOAI compliance and rigorous publication standards.

IJMRGE is a peer-reviewed open-access journal published by Anfo Publication House, accepting manuscripts across multiple disciplines with double-blind peer review and Vancouver style formatting. The journal maintains strict ethical standards aligned with COPE guidelines and uses Turnitin for plagiarism detection.

## Key Topics

- Open-Access Publishing
- Peer Review Process
- Manuscript Submission
- Publication Ethics
- BOAI Compliance
- Double-Blind Review
- Creative Commons License
- Multidisciplinary Research
- Author Instructions
- Editorial Policies
- Plagiarism Detection
- Conflict of Interest
- Informed Consent
- Academic Journal Standards
